description: Apply Solhint autofixes to a Solidity source string and return the corrected source. Touches no file — use it for source not saved yet; for a file on disk use fix_file.

config.description: Optional Solhint config, e.g. { extends: 'solhint:recommended' }. Rule maps and solhint:* presets only; 'extends' paths and 'plugins' are rejected.

name: fix_solidity
